item_short_desc: Rothco’s Marine Corps Decal is a 3” round outside decal. Outside application decals can be easily applied to the exterior of any flat, clean, and dry surface like a window or truck. United States Marine CORPS printed on the front in white lettering with a black background, Marine eagle, globe, and anchor emblem pictured on the front with a red background.
